gaps.explanation: pp6-7 governmental funds statement Transfers in (out): General Fund 113,390, Street Fund 28,205, Sinking Fund (48,923), Library Memorial Fund (5,266), Total Governmental Funds 87,406. JSON transfers_in = 87,406 (Total column, which nets the intra-governmental transfers) and transfers_out = null. Detail records the fund columns gross: General Fund departments 42,304 + 30,368 + 16,917 + 5,291 + 18,510 = 113,390 (pp19-20) + Street Fund 28,205 (p13) = 141,595 in; Sinking Fund (48,923) (p14) and Library Memorial Fund (5,266) (p15) out. 141,595 - 87,406 = 54,189 = 48,923 + 5,266, the intra-governmental transfers the Total column nets. Detail is correct as printed; no fix.

No business-type lines in detail. p9 Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Net Position - Proprietary Funds: JSON business-type receipts = Consumers 1,474,042 + Service charges 8,832 + Miscellaneous 9,882 + Interest income 11,684 + Grant income 52,802 + Unrealized loss on investments (54,746) = 1,502,496. Per column: Electric Fund 951,771 + 5,678 + 8,087 + 10,797 + 24,379 - 54,746 = 945,966; Water Fund 154,404 + 975 + 878 + 364 = 156,621; Sewer Fund 172,913 + 1,204 + 369 + 523 + 6,620 = 181,629; Sanitation Fund 194,954 + 975 + 548 + 21,803 = 218,280. Sum 1,502,496 = statement total. The unrealized loss is a receipts line in the JSON, so it is added as a negative revenue line (as printed).
